# Identities that do not need a CLA sign-off trailer.
#
# The CLA (see CLA.md) binds OUTSIDE contributors. The project owner already
# holds the copyright and does not sign an agreement with themselves, and
# automation does not hold copyright at all.
#
# This file is the single declaration of who that is. `commit_hygiene.rs`
# reads it; nothing else decides. Adding a maintainer means adding a line here
# and nowhere else.
#
# One identity per line, matched against the commit author's name OR email,
# exactly. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.

# The project owner — the copyright holder named in LICENSE. Listed under both
# spellings because the LICENSE drops the diacritic and git does not.

# authorship.
